name: Absorbing Man

abilityDetails.Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): İyileşmesi çok yoğun, özel counter şart. E2'yi 2 kez kullanmasına izin verme — yakma uygular. Özel saldırılarından sonra ağır saldırı kullan, zehirli veya petrify'lı şampiyon tercih et.
signatureAbility:
Breaker of Wills
Absorbing Man's Omni-Morph Forms last [9.7 - 40]% longer.
When Absorbing Man consumes Morph Charges, he gains a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing [9.85 - 30]% of his missing Health over 12 seconds. As a Defender, this effect also triggers whenever Absorbing Man enters or refreshes any Form.
Personal Regeneration effects pause for 3 seconds when Absorbing Man is struck with True Damage and are removed when a form is deactivated early.

abilitySections.title: Molecular Duplication - Always Active
content: A fluid molecular structure grants Absorbing Man 20% Crit Resistance and Immunity to Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuffs, but reduces his Critical Penetration by 20% flat.
Absorbing Man is no stranger to brawling with beings of otherworldly resilience. He reduces the duration of his Opponent's Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable, and Unblockable Buffs by 90%.

abilitySections.title: Omni-Morph Forms
content: Absorbing Man's Special Attacks transform him into powerful altered Forms. He can only be in one Form at a time, and Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification.
Absorbing Man starts each fight in his Black Uru Form by default, but can use the Pre-Fight Menu to change this default, which persists until changed again.
Being struck by a Heavy Attack while recovering from a Special Attack deactivates the current Form, which cannot be deactivated again in this way for 20 seconds.
Whenever a Buff ends on the Opponent or Absorbing Man is Immune to a Debuff, the current Form pauses for 3 seconds.
Interrupting an Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack pauses the current Form for 6 seconds and inflicts a [485.29] potency Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.

abilitySections.title: Refined Forms
content: If Absorbing Man would enter a Form that is already active, he instead Refines the Form, refreshing its duration and granting additional benefits.
Personal bursts of damage benefit from 300% of Absorbing Man's Critical Damage Multiplier when he lands a Critical Hit and cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
Blocking a Hit reduces the Opponent's Ability Power Rate by 72% until Absorbing Man stops blocking. The Power denied is transferred to Absorbing Man.

abilitySections.title: Morph Charges
content: When Absorbing Man refreshes or changes Forms, he gains Morph Charges equal to the remaining percentage of his previous Form's base duration. Max: 600.
Whenever Absorbing Man is Immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff, he gains 90 Morph Charges.

Performing a Medium, Light, Medium Combo with at least 150 Morph Charges, or activating a Special Attack at max charges consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict one 30 second Vulnerability Passive with [2,750] potency for every 150 Charges consumed.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: This attack gains [2,250] Critical Rating if the Opponent is Stunned as the first hit lands.
This attack instead gains [24,750] Critical Rating if the Opponent is not Stunned as the first hit lands.
Activating a Special Attack after the first hit lands applies this bonus Critical Rating to the entire Special and grants 30 Morph Charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, enter Black Uru Form for 10 seconds, granting the following benefits:
Gain Immunity to all Bleed and Shock effects and +[11,000] Physical Resistance.
All attacks deal a burst of [2,014.2] Physical Damage.
Refined: Absorbing Man can perform Critical Hits and trigger personal bursts of damage through the Opponent's Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, enter Magma Form for 18 seconds, granting the following benefits:
Gain Immunity to all Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects and +[11,000] Energy Resistance.
All attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical, as well as a burst of [2,014.2] Energy Damage.
Refined: Contact with the Opponent inflicts an Incinerate Passive, dealing [3,524.85] Energy Damage over 1 second.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain an indefinite Cruelty Passive, increasing Critical Damage Rating by [144.74]. If a Refined Form is already active, gain a second Cruelty Passive. Max Stacks: 5.
Activate the most recent Form in its Refined state. Pause it for 15 seconds. While this Pause is active, Absorbing Man gains [11,000] Critical Rating.
